description_en: Performs a paged query of scan tasks under a specified scan target for AI Red Teaming. Supports filtering by detection intensity, task status, and scan mode
description_zh: AI Red Teaming，分页查询指定扫描目标下的扫描任务，支持按检测强度、任务状态与扫描模式过滤
name: ListScanTasksByTarget

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the scan target. Only tasks under this target are queried. If the target does not exist or does not belong to the current tenant, HTTP status code 400 is returned
parameters.help_zh: 扫描目标的唯一标识，仅查询该目标下的任务；目标不存在或不归属当前租户时返回 400
parameters.name: target_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100. Values greater than 100 are clamped to 100. Values less than 1 return HTTP status code 400
parameters.help_zh: 每页条数，默认 10，单页上限 100；大于 100 时钳制为 100，小于 1 时返回 400
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number, starting from 1. Values less than 1 are normalized to 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始；小于 1 时归一为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: Filters by detection intensity. If this parameter is not specified, no filtering by intensity is applied
parameters.help_zh: 按检测强度过滤；不传则不按强度过滤
parameters.name: sample_level

parameters.help_en: Filters by task status. If this parameter is not specified, tasks in all statuses are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按任务状态过滤；不传返回全部状态
parameters.name: task_status

parameters.help_en: Filters by scan type. If this parameter is not specified, tasks of all scan types are returned
parameters.help_zh: 按扫描模式过滤；不传返回全部模式
parameters.name: scan_type

Data.description_en: The list of scan tasks on the current page
Data.description_zh: 当前页的扫描任务列表

CreateTime.description_en: The task creation time, in milliseconds (Unix epoch milliseconds)
CreateTime.description_zh: 任务创建时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）

EndTime.description_en: The task end time, in milliseconds (Unix epoch milliseconds). This value is null if the task has not ended
EndTime.description_zh: 任务结束时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）；任务未结束时为 null

ExecuteCaseCount.description_en: The number of samples that the task has executed
ExecuteCaseCount.description_zh: 任务已执行的样本数量

RiskLevel.description_en: The risk level of the task result. This value is null if the task is not completed or no risk assessment has been generated
RiskLevel.description_zh: 任务结果的风险等级；任务未完成或未产生风险评定时为 null

SampleLevel.description_en: The detection intensity of the task

ScanType.description_en: The scan type of the task. Historical tasks without a recorded scan type are normalized to attack
ScanType.description_zh: 任务的扫描模式；历史未记录扫描模式的任务归一为 attack

ScannerTaskId.description_en: The unique identifier of the scan task. You can use this ID for result download and status tracking
ScannerTaskId.description_zh: 扫描任务的唯一标识，可用于结果下载与状态跟踪

ScannerTaskMessage.description_en: The task message. This value contains the failure reason if the task failed, or is empty if the task succeeded or no message is available
ScannerTaskMessage.description_zh: 任务消息；失败时为失败原因，成功或无消息时为空

ScannerTaskStatus.description_en: The current status of the task

StartTime.description_en: The task start time, in milliseconds (Unix epoch milliseconds). This value is null if the task has not started
StartTime.description_zh: 任务开始时间，毫秒时间戳（Unix epoch 毫秒）；任务未开始时为 null

TaskName.description_en: The task name. If no name is specified during creation, the default value is "Target Scan - target name"
TaskName.description_zh: 任务名称；创建时未指定则默认为"Target Scan - 目标名称"
TaskName.example: Target Scan - 我的百炼靶标

TotalCaseCount.description_en: The total number of samples that the task plans to execute
TotalCaseCount.description_zh: 任务计划执行的样本总数

PageNumber.description_en: The normalized page number that actually takes effect. This value may differ from the input parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 归一化后的实际生效页码，不一定等于入参

PageSize.description_en: The normalized number of entries per page that actually takes effect. This value may differ from the input parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 归一化后的实际生效每页条数，不一定等于入参

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, used for troubleshooting and log tracing
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与日志追踪

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of scan tasks that match the filter conditions within the last 366-day window
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的扫描任务总数（最近 366 天窗口内）
